sloka: मद् बलेन विरुद्धाय न स्यात् दैव बलम् तथा ।प्रभविष्यति दुह्खाय यथा उग्रम् पौरुषम् मम ॥२-२३-२४॥
transliteration: mad balena viruddhāya na syāt daiva balam tathā ।prabhaviṣyati duhkhāya yathā ugram pauruṣam mama ॥2-23-24॥

translations.english: Any one who opposes my terrible valour will come to grief. The power of destiny will not cause that much sorrow as my valour will.
